Class WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.spring.security.WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.context.SecurityContextRepository
public class WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.context.SecurityContextRepository
Keeps only a WhoSession (ids) in the HTTP session and re-resolves the principal from WhoService on every request, so a suspended identity, a removed role or a revoked credential takes effect immediately.

    • PRINCIPAL_INDEX_ATTRIBUTE

      public static final String PRINCIPAL_INDEX_ATTRIBUTE
      Name of the session attribute Spring Session indexes by principal name. who sets it to the identity id, so FindByIndexNameSessionRepository.findByPrincipalName(identityId) finds every session of an identity. The literal avoids a dependency on Spring Session.
